claim: Scalable-Softmax: softmax's max element approaches zero as input size grows, flattening attention as context grows and potentially limiting length generalisation
quote: The maximum element of the vector output by the Softmax function approaches zero as the input vector size increases. Transformer-based language models rely on Softmax to compute attention scores, causing the attention distribution to flatten as the context size grows. This reduces the model's ability to prioritize key information effectively and potentially limits its length generalization.
notes: Second independent statement of dispersion; SSMax is a drop-in fix (T1-sharp candidate)
